strongest_angle: Examine the Thomson Reuters 2026 Labor and Employment Law Developments Tracker, which monitors federal and state court decisions, regulations, and administrative agency guidance.

key_facts.fact: Thomson Reuters publishes the 2026 Labor & Employment Law Developments Tracker as a Practice Note tracking key US labor and employment law developments enacted or issued in 2026.
The 2026 Labor and Employment Law Developments Tracker excludes traditional labor law and immigration law, which are tracked in separate resources by Thomson Reuters.
The September 2026 release of the Guide to Employment Law and Regulation, 2d includes material on civil rights immunity issues and qualified immunity in a section 1983 action.
